scope: diagnosis of the original failed v1 model; all new labelled probes use calibration only

findings.hypothesis: crop or coordinate mapping gross error
findings.evidence: synthetic pixel-coordinate ramps through actual crop agree with affine within 1.6e-5 pixel; no off-by-one label mapping found in source review
findings.conclusion: no gross crop bug found; small half-pixel normalized-grid discrepancy remains <=0.0048 and was not changed in v2

findings.hypothesis: trained visual branch is simply worse at single-frame restoration
findings.evidence: 160 fixed calibration frames: TWM one-round unaligned joint48.14mm, old visual1round43.07mm, old visual2round43.01mm
findings.conclusion: not supported; visual improves the single-frame objective, while second round adds little joint benefit

findings.hypothesis: iterated TWM residual is the sole main cause
findings.evidence: Full20 calibration videos,39310 per-segment eligible frames: raw W29.381,TWM once29.191,TWM twice29.439mm
findings.conclusion: Recurrence contributes about0.248mm here; insufficient to explain original14.086mm test deterioration

findings.hypothesis: visual updates are overly large for trajectory/metric robustness
findings.evidence: original prediction-only root updates mean1.10mm TWM vs11.07mm intra; control bounded transplant reduces20frame root displacement18.8mm->4.53mm but increases unaligned joint loss
findings.conclusion: updates are larger, but clipping old weights alone does not prove improved metric; train bounded model with sequence objectives

findings.evidence: oldloss absolute single-frame MPJPE+NLL; test uses first2frame similarity alignment in100frame segments; best checkpoint chosen on20middle frames
findings.conclusion: Supported mismatch. Superseded v2 pilot stopped at49 steps without test. Protocol3 retains camera supervision and adds canonical-world trajectory supervision plus full-video event calibration.

findings.hypothesis: camera-relative supervision differs from formal world target
findings.evidence: 5120 fixed calibration frames,3280 scored: perfect camera-relative labels have9.938mm first2-aligned world error; independently regenerated raw-SLAM labels agree within0.000133mm
findings.conclusion: Add label-only A^-1 G S^-1 J_S world supervision; retain camera-relative objective; no GT added to model inputs

findings.hypothesis: event calibration coverage and boundary mismatch
findings.evidence: Original40windows contain8 refs and baseline only1match; segment-split reference omitted6events. Correct full-video reference224events,130mergedwindows,18468frames; exact formal prediction mask39330frames
findings.conclusion: Use full224reference trace, expanded fixed prediction coverage, global formal mask, baseline>=10matches and nondegrading F1/recall for selection

unresolved: whether repaired training improves full calibration W/Onset/F1
whether calibration-selected model generalizes to the previously observed frozen test
